requiredRetainedSourceWork: Verify the primary regulatory basis, product and jurisdiction scope of the retained Nowak-review-attributed 10 ng DNA statement before using it as an acceptance criterion. The secondary review statement is now read and confirmed, but it is not a universal RNA-product limit.

Facility locations, supply/patent rankings and industrialisation forecasts were intentionally withdrawn pending primary verification. They are not called false, and can only be reintroduced with dated primary support.

sourceCautions.scope: Figure 1 caption glosses q2w as twice a week; main text specifies six weekly and two biweekly administrations with final day 64. The record uses the main-text schedule as every other week, not the erroneous caption gloss.
sourceCautions.credit: No clinical recommendation or global schedule inference.

sourceCautions.scope: Crossref supplies the registered abstract. The DOI landing returned 403; no challenge was bypassed.
Initial DOI resolution returned HTTP 503 with no response body retained; fresh Crossref and EPMC retry captures both returned 200.

The 10 ng/dose statement is confirmed as a statement in this secondary manufacturing review. The underlying primary regulatory basis, applicable product context and jurisdiction remain required verification before treating it as a release criterion. The current field attributes it to the review; the new notes do not adopt a universal RNA cutoff.

limits: No original paper, review or FDA guidance was read end to end. Thirteen complete abstracts, specified targeted primary/review paragraphs and eight text pages from four FDA PDFs retain their stated reading depth.

The residual-DNA statement remains attributed to a secondary review; product/jurisdiction applicability of a primary regulatory criterion remains required work.
